title: Test burst — E2E after a clean machine review · MVP as built, 2026-07

messages.label: Assess came back clean (APPROVE) → queue test
messages.note: the funnel: no sandbox boot for a diff that's about to change; a pushed dev round re-queues assess first

messages.label: Read TESTING.md at the PR head
messages.note: the product's declared plug: frontmatter (env names, tools) for the platform, prose for the tester

messages.label: Env intersection: TEST_X provisioned ∧ manifest asks X → inject as X
messages.note: the manifest is untrusted — a hostile request for anything outside TEST_* gets nothing

messages.label: Spawn test burst: TESTING.md prose + envelope prompt · FRESH session · clone ro at PR head · NO GitHub credential
messages.note: deliberately blind to the PR conversation — the dev cannot sweet-talk the tester

messages.label: Copy clone to scratch; boot the product
Invent scenarios from the command reference + specs, weighted to the PR's diff
exit — structured report is the final message, returned via harvest
messages.note: verdict + scenarios (pass/fail) + defects (preexisting?) + authored symptom issues

messages.label: Post as reviewer App: PR-caused defects → REQUEST_CHANGES review · clean → advisory comment
messages.note: a REQUEST_CHANGES report drives a normal dev round — same machinery, same caps

messages.label: Relay pre-existing defects as auto issues (≤3, deduped) — never ready
messages.note: the monitor's pipeline arriving early; the human gate authorizes all work

messages.label: 🧪 report informs gate 2 (advisory, not a required check)
